headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: The 150 United flights in the air are 78% fewer than usual for this time of day: over the past 7 days, the median at this hour was 680. The schedule is lighter today too, with about 45% fewer departures scheduled from United's hubs over the past four hours than usual.
All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better.
No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 United hubs with a current report.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying United today, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
